title: MouseWithoutBorders multiple threads conflicting access to settings.json

judgment.rationale: The open PR already changes the reported save path; do not propose a competing implementation. Its bounded retries are not a guarantee of full resolution.
evidence: The original 0.70 report includes repeated MouseWithoutBorders settings.json sharing-violation save stacks; later reporters observed the error through 0.98.
Open PR 51080 explicitly relates its C# atomic save and bounded retry work to this issue, while acknowledging collisions can still lose saves.
Read the complete discussion and linked PR: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51080
A related public report supplies Process Monitor comparisons: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/51682.
judgment.recommended_action: Monitor the existing settings save PR
